summary: Full-extraction pass over 20 stored Egyptian documents: the programme website (4 pages), Law 140/2019, the three regulating PM decrees (3099/2019, 876/2023, 3562/2023) and 12 naturalisation decrees. Adds nationality splits for every naturalisation decree, the website's current terms and advertised processing times, and holding periods, instalment periods and time limits from the law and decrees. 19 documents complete; the FAQ is partial because only its first page was stored.

program_terms.quote: شراء عقار  بمبلغ لا يقل عن 300 ألف دولار (ثلاث مائة ألف دولار أمريكى)  يحول من الخارج
program_terms.notes: Programme website page as captured 2026-10-02 (undated); valid_from left empty because the page gives no date (the amounts were set by PM Decree 876/2023 and 3562/2023). Any property (the page no longer says state-owned).

program_terms.applies_to: applicant
program_terms.quote: إنشاء أو المشاركة في مشروع استثماري بمبلغ لا يقل عن 350 ألف دولار (ثلاث مائة وخمسون ألف دولار أمريكي)  يحول من الخارج
program_terms.notes: Programme website page as captured 2026-10-02 (undated); valid_from left empty because the page gives no date (the amounts were set by PM Decree 876/2023 and 3562/2023). Plus a non-refundable USD 100,000 Treasury payment (next row).

program_terms.applies_to: applicant (in addition to the project)
program_terms.quote: مع إيداع مبلغ مائة ألف دولار أمريكى كإيرادات مباشرة بالعملة الأجنبية تؤول الى الخزانة العامة للدولة ولا يرد
program_terms.notes: Programme website page as captured 2026-10-02 (undated); valid_from left empty because the page gives no date (the amounts were set by PM Decree 876/2023 and 3562/2023). Non-refundable.

program_terms.applies_to: investment project route: project plus Treasury payment, as headlined by the page
program_terms.quote: إنشاء مشروع استثماري بحد أدني 450 ألف دولار
program_terms.notes: Programme website page as captured 2026-10-02 (undated); valid_from left empty because the page gives no date (the amounts were set by PM Decree 876/2023 and 3562/2023). The page headline for the project route; it is the USD 350,000 project plus the USD 100,000 Treasury payment (both printed on the page). Not a separate requirement.

program_terms.applies_to: applicant
program_terms.quote: إيداع مبلغ خمسمائة ألف دولار أمريكى بموجب تحويل بنكى من الخارج في حساب خاص بالبنك المركزي المصري، كوديعة يتم استردادها بعد مرور ثلاث سنوات
program_terms.notes: Programme website page as captured 2026-10-02 (undated); valid_from left empty because the page gives no date (the amounts were set by PM Decree 876/2023 and 3562/2023). Refunded after 3 years in Egyptian pounds at the exchange rate on the day of refund, without interest.

program_terms.applies_to: applicant
program_terms.quote: إيداع مبلغ  250 ألف دولار (مائتين وخمسين ألف دولار أمريكي) بموجب تحويل بنكى من الخارج  كإيرادات مباشرة  (منحة) تؤول إلى الخزانة العامة للدولة، ولايرد.
program_terms.notes: Programme website page as captured 2026-10-02 (undated); valid_from left empty because the page gives no date (the amounts were set by PM Decree 876/2023 and 3562/2023). Non-refundable grant to the Treasury.

program_terms.applies_to: property bought under the programme: selling it earlier requires the USD 250,000 payment to keep citizenship
program_terms.quote: وفى حالة التصرف فى العقار قبل مرور خمس سنوات على تاريخ الحصول عليه، فيشترط للاحتفاظ بالجنسية المصرية إيداع مبلغ مائتين وخمسين ألف دولار أمريكى
program_terms.notes: Programme website page as captured 2026-10-02 (undated); valid_from left empty because the page gives no date (the amounts were set by PM Decree 876/2023 and 3562/2023).

program_terms.applies_to: investment project: liquidating, stopping or selling it (or the share) earlier requires the USD 250,000 payment to keep citizenship
program_terms.quote: وفى حالة تصفية أو إيقاف المشروع الاستثمارى  أو تصرف المتجنس فيه أو فى حصته قبل مرور خمس سنوات على تاريخ تشغيله، فيشترط للاحتفاظ بالجنسية المصرية إيداع مبلغ مائتين وخمسين ألف دولار أمريكى
program_terms.notes: Programme website page as captured 2026-10-02 (undated); valid_from left empty because the page gives no date (the amounts were set by PM Decree 876/2023 and 3562/2023).

program_terms.applies_to: naturalised person who sells the property or the project (or share) within 5 years, to keep citizenship
program_terms.quote: إيداع مبلغ مائتين وخمسين ألف دولار أمريكى فى البنك المركزى بموجب تحويل بنكى من الخارج، كإيرادات مباشرة تؤول إلى الخزانة العامة للدولة، ولا يرد.
program_terms.notes: Programme website page as captured 2026-10-02 (undated); valid_from left empty because the page gives no date (the amounts were set by PM Decree 876/2023 and 3562/2023). Non-refundable; printed identically under the property and the project routes. New route name: no existing route fits a payment due on early sale.

program_terms.applies_to: property (USD 300,000) and Treasury payment (USD 250,000) routes
program_terms.quote: ويجوز تقسيط المبلغ خلال مدة لا تجاوز سنة،
program_terms.notes: Programme website page as captured 2026-10-02 (undated); valid_from left empty because the page gives no date (the amounts were set by PM Decree 876/2023 and 3562/2023). On default or withdrawal, sums paid are refunded in Egyptian pounds without interest.

program_terms.applies_to: per application (non-refundable)
program_terms.quote: يقوم المستثمر بأداء رسم غير مسترد قيمته عشرة ألاف دولار أمريكي أو ما يعادله بالعملات الأجنبية
program_terms.notes: Programme website page as captured 2026-10-02 (undated). Paid by bank transfer from abroad, or cash declared at customs, into the Cabinet unit account at the Central Bank.

program_terms.applies_to: applicant after the Prime Minister's initial approval, to complete the investment
program_terms.quote: يمنح طالب التجنس حق الإقامة المؤقتة في مصر لمدة ستة أشهر وذلك لاستكمال التنفيذ الفعلى للبرنامج الاستثمارى
program_terms.notes: Programme website page as captured 2026-10-02 (undated).

program_terms.applies_to: Treasury payment (USD 250,000) and property (USD 300,000) routes only
program_terms.location: FAQ 'هل يوجد تسهيلات لسداد مبالغ البرامج الاستثمارية؟'
program_terms.quote: يجوز فقط تقسيط مبلغ التبرع للخزانة العامة للدولة (250 ألف دولار) أو مبلغ برنامج شراء العقار ( 300 ألف دولار) خلال مدة لا تجاوز سنة.
program_terms.notes: Programme website FAQ page 1 of 2 as captured 2026-10-02 (undated). Citizenship only after full payment; temporary non-tourist residence during the instalment period; refund in EGP without interest on default.

program_terms.applies_to: citizenship acquired by fraud or false statements may be withdrawn within this period after acquisition

program_terms.notes: Programme website FAQ page 1 of 2 as captured 2026-10-02 (undated). General rule of the Nationality Law as stated by the programme FAQ.

program_terms.applies_to: citizenship may be withdrawn within this period after acquisition on conviction in Egypt for a felony or a custodial sentence for a crime of dishonour
program_terms.quote: كما يجوز سحبها خلال السنوات الخمس التالية لاكتسابه إياها إذا حكم عليه فى مصر بعقوبة جناية
program_terms.notes: Programme website FAQ page 1 of 2 as captured 2026-10-02 (undated).

program_terms.applies_to: property (item 1) and Treasury payment (item 4) routes
program_terms.quote: ويجوز تقسيط المبالغ المنصوص عليها فى البندين
program_terms.notes: Items (1) and (4): property and Treasury payment; period "خلال مدة لا تجاوز سنة" (within a period not exceeding one year). Citizenship granted only after full payment; temporary non-tourist residence during instalments; refund in EGP without interest on default or withdrawal. In force the day after publication (Gazette 2 Mar 2023). Quote normalised (NFKC) from the text layer.

program_terms.applies_to: per application (or EGP equivalent)

program_terms.applies_to: property route: applicant must file an undertaking not to dispose of the property for five years

program_terms.notes: One of six documents now required for the property route (purchase contract, property licence, utility receipt, proof of deposit at a licensed bank, this undertaking, proof of registration or state supervision). Quote normalised (NFKC).

ledger.contains: Programme website 'About us' page (captured 2026-10-02): legal basis (Law 140/2019; PM Decrees 3099/2019 and 3562/2023 regulating the grants; PM Decree 647/2020 forming the Cabinet unit), the four kinds of qualifying act described in words (buying property, an investment project under Investment Law 72/2017, a foreign-currency payment to the Treasury or an interest-free deposit at the Central Bank), and the unit's reception office at GAFI. No amounts, fees or counts printed. The 647/2020 event is already recorded from this page; nothing else in scope.

Programme website 'Investment programmes' page (captured 2026-10-02, undated): the four routes with their minimums (property USD 300,000; investment project USD 350,000 plus USD 100,000 to the Treasury, headlined as USD 450,000; USD 500,000 Central Bank deposit refunded in EGP after 3 years without interest; USD 250,000 non-refundable Treasury payment), the 5-year holding rule for property and projects with the USD 250,000 payment to keep citizenship on earlier sale, and instalments over up to one year for the property and Treasury-payment routes with refund in EGP on default. No statistics. All recorded as terms.

Programme website 'Steps' page (captured 2026-10-02, undated): five steps: application form and documents (passport copy, 6 photos, criminal records from origin and Egypt, travel record for the previous 5 years, medical certificate); non-refundable USD 10,000 fee with the Central Bank account details; completeness notice within 3 working days and initial decision within 3 to 6 months; 6 months' temporary residence after initial approval to complete the investment; final decree within at most 3 months. Fee and residence period recorded as terms, the three advertised times as observations (claim). The '6 photos' and '5 years' of travel records are document requirements, not recorded.

Programme website FAQ, page 1 of 2 only ('[15 عناصر]', 10 questions shown): instalments over up to one year for the USD 250,000 Treasury payment and USD 300,000 property routes; no military service for naturalised children; withdrawal of citizenship within 10 years (fraud) or 5 years (conviction); dual nationality allowed; citizenship passes to children; permanent; no language test; 6-12 months to a passport; 6-month residence permit after applying; all nationalities may apply. Rules recorded as terms, the 6-12 months as an observation (claim).

ledger.contains: Law 140 of 2019 (30 July 2019), law-firm transcription: Art. 1 replaces Art. 17 of the Aliens Law 89/1960 (three residence categories, i.e. drops the deposit-residence category); Art. 2 replaces Nationality Law Art. 4 bis (Prime Minister may naturalise foreigners who buy state property, set up an investment project, or pay foreign currency to the Treasury or as a Central Bank deposit, per a PM decree); Art. 3 adds Art. 4 bis 1 (Cabinet unit with members from Foreign Affairs, Interior, Investment and security agencies) and 4 bis 2 (USD 10,000 fee, confidentiality option, initial decision within 3 months, 6 months' temporary residence, final recommendation within 3 months); Art. 4 repeals Art. 20 bis of Law 89/1960; Art. 5 entry into force. Fee and event were already recorded; the two time limits and the residence period added as terms. No statistics.

PM Decree 3099 of 18 Dec 2019 (Gazette No. 50 bis (c), 3-page scan, OCR): Art. 1 routes: state property USD 500,000 (Housing Minister to list available buildings and land within 30 days), investment project USD 400,000 with at least 40% of capital, deposits of USD 750,000 for 5 years or USD 1 million for 3 years refunded in EGP without interest, USD 250,000 non-refundable Treasury payment; deposits and payments held in a special account within the Treasury Single Account; 5-year holding rule for property and projects with the USD 250,000 payment to keep citizenship; Art. 2 creates the Cabinet unit; Art. 3 in force the day after publication. Route amounts and the launch event were already recorded; holding periods and the 40% share added as terms. The 30-day listing deadline is an administrative deadline, not recorded.

PM Decree 876 of 2 Mar 2023 (Gazette No. 9 cont. (c), pp. 2-5) amending Decree 3099/2019: Art. 1 new route amounts (state property USD 300,000; project USD 350,000 plus USD 100,000 to the Treasury; USD 500,000 deposit refunded after 3 years in EGP without interest; USD 250,000 Treasury payment), funds may also enter as cash declared at customs; Art. 2 instalments over up to one year for items 1 and 4; Art. 3 in force the next day. All amounts and the price-change event were already recorded; the instalment period added as a term.

PM Decree 3562 of 18 Sep 2023 (Gazette No. 37 bis, pp. 2-4) amending Decrees 3099/2019 and 647/2020: Art. 1 property route becomes any property of at least USD 300,000 (no longer state-owned); Art. 2 USD 10,000 fee may be paid as EGP equivalent by bank transfer from abroad; Art. 3 six documents required for the property route including a 5-year no-sale undertaking; Art. 4 in force the next day. Property term and event were already recorded; fee and holding period added as terms.

The total was already recorded; nationality split added. Names, birthplaces and birth dates are personal data and not recorded; no amounts or routes are given.
